findings.title: I / district average salary spreads survival by 62 points
findings.statement: Lowest quartile of inflow_vs_district_salary (-0.001 to 0.564) survives 95% of the time; highest quartile (2.25 to 8.22) 33%.
findings.caveat: Quartile spread; not adjusted for income.

findings.title: Flag 'Spending close to income' moves layoff survival by -53 points
findings.statement: 1847 accounts with 'Spending close to income' survive six months on 55% income 33% of the time versus 86% for the other 2653.
findings.caveat: Flags correlate with income and buffer; this is a difference, not a cause.
